newsitem.title: USA: Revlon reports sharply higher profits.
newsitem.headline: Revlon reports sharply higher profits.

text.p: Cosmetic giant Revlon Inc. Tuesday reported sharply higher profits for the third quarter, thanks to a double-digit leap in worldwide sales.
The company said it had net earnings of $21.1 million, or 41 cents a share, versus year-ago profits of $3.4 million, or 8 cents a share.
Sales increased 11 percent to $571.1 million, vs. $514.5 million in last year's third quarter.
U.S. sales increased 10.7 percent to $344.7 million for the third quarter, and international sales gained 11.5 percent to $226.4 million.
The Revlon brand's share of the total U.S. mass cosmetics market was 21.8 percent for the quarter, compared with 19.3 percent a year earlier, it said.
Revlon's stock gained 87.5 cents to $34.125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
